row: Welcome to my channel!!! Im a Registered Veterinary Technician but my most important job is the title of "Dog Mom" to my two Golden Doodle boys (Cooper and Denahi) and my Cavalier King Charles (Ivy).  This page is dedicated toward helping you navigate the hard questions that pop up as pet parents and tech you ways to care for your pets at home!  Come with me to navigate the crazy world of being a pet parent!
